summary.text: Devin Kreinbring is the Workers Party candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives, 10th Suffolk District, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democratic incumbent Bill MacGregor.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as mechanic, and in a Ballotpedia survey he described himself as a medical equipment repairman.

paragraphs.text: Kreinbring attended Vero Beach High School and earned an associate degree from Indian River State College in 2016, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Kreinbring said he is running to help organize working people and does not expect to win the election.
He listed his key messages as the need for a workers party, working-class solidarity against bigotry and systemic oppression, and internationalism and opposition to imperialism and war.
He named the Workers Party of Massachusetts as his endorser.
